propwash.guide.scene.sharing.title: Sharing builds
propwash.guide.scene.sharing.description: Share codes: pass on build, paint and tune as text
propwash.guide.scene.sharing.step.export: In the workbench, “Share code” shows the finished build as a short text. “Copy to clipboard” takes paint, tune and name along.
propwash.guide.scene.sharing.step.import: Under “Import” you see preview, flight values, add-ons and parts check. “Apply” fills the workbench, in creative with new parts.
propwash.guide.scene.sharing.step.shoppi: In survival the parts come from your inventory. Whatever is missing is on the shopping list – nothing is given away.
propwash.guide.scene.sharing.step.held.t: In the configurator tab “Share code” you apply only tune or paint to the drone in your hand. Paint costs dyes.
propwash.guide.scene.sharing.callout.exp: Share code: the build as text
propwash.guide.scene.sharing.callout.sho: Part missing? It's on the shopping list
propwash.guide.scene.sharing.callout.hel: Tune and paint right on the drone

propwash.share.pwd1.build: PWD1 holds only the editor values; the build is the freestyle drone with the Creative Flight Controller.
propwash.command.code.creative_survival: Creative values apply in creative mode only; in survival only paint and tuning are applied.
